content.rendered:
How It Works

We instantly create a private QR code for your event that saves all full resolution photos to your live photo gallery or albums.

How It Works For Guests

1. Guests Scan QR Code

With a quick scan of your QR Code, or a simple click of your private link, guests can instantly upload photos, videos, and guestbook messages.

Bonus: Invite your guests with our new Digital Invitation and RSVP tool.

Only takes 2 mins to create!

2. Upload Memories

Guests are greeted with your welcome screen where they add their name (so you know who’s accessed) and can immediately upload photos, videos and guest book messages. No guest registration needed. Compatible with any device.

3. Enjoy & Relive

You and your guests will love revisiting the best moments in your digital gallery.

As the host, you’re in complete control, with highly customizable settings to make the gallery perfectly tailored to your celebration.

Your digital gallery will be the go-to destination in the days and weeks after your event! 

Pricing

How It Works For Hosts

CREATE YOUR EVENT

After purchase, add your event date, event title, and a short welcome message for your guests. This will be your welcome page for guests once they scan your QR code or click your private link. For album packages, we recommend a separate album per event.

DISPLAY YOUR QR CODE

Display your QR code at your event. You can even copy and send your private link to guests digitally. Use our QR code generator to generate your personal dynamic QR Code with customized colors or use our default color scheme. 

ENJOY YOUR MEMORIES

You and your guests will love seeing the best moments roll into your digital gallery! As the host, you are in control. You can customize the features of GUESTPIX™ in whichever way suits you and your event.

Pricing tailored to your event type

Packages and inclusions are matched to your occasion – select yours to explore.

with GUESTPIX™ you'll enjoy...

social engagement​

Receive 2x guests, 2x photos and 5x uploads with our private social experience included with all packages

live slideshow

Activate the slideshow and watch as photos are automatically added each rotation. It’s a great way to showcase your celebration for all to enjoy!

written & video guestbook

Receive written and video guest book photo messages from guests in a CSV file. It’s the perfect accompaniment to your photo collection, no matter what type of event you’re hosting.

digital invitations

Easily set up a digital invitation in seconds! Share your invitation link with guests (sms, email, chat). No printing, no hassle.

QR code & private link

Your custom QR code is your ticket to receiving content from your guests. Add it to invitations, table cards, signage, and more! Or send your private link digitally.

180+ Canva templates

Receive links to 180+ Canva templates to edit and print locally with your QR code. Includes welcome sign, table cards, mini take-home cards and I Spy game.

super albums

Our album technology is the best in market and provides privacy and access controls that elevate albums to events in their own right

zip download

Ready to download your event gallery? Everything is zipped and ready to download within 12 months of your event. It’s the perfect way to keep, share or print in the future.

All organized like digital photo and video guestbook and delivered to you so you don't miss a moment!

Event already over?

Purchasing after your event is just as easy. Simply send your private link to guests and start receiving photos and content instantly!

Pricing

What event are you planning?

From weddings, celebrations, group holidays and festivals, to small business and corporate events, we’ve got your guest photos covered!

WEDDINGS

From the night before to the big day, see every moment of your wedding and treasure the memories forever.

Weddings

CELEBRATIONS

From graduations and reunions to baby showers and religious celebrations. Enjoy every moment through the eyes of your guests.

Celebrations

BUSINESS

Hosting a corporate or community event? No matter the size, increase event engagement, see the highlights, and gather testimonials.

Business

MEMORIALS

You and your memorial guests can upload their favorite memories to share and leave written messages of support for you and the family.

Memorials

ENGAGEMENTS

From the moment you said yes, the celebrations begin! From the engagement party to the bachelorette, bring every moment together.

Engagements

KIDS PARTIES

From birthday parties and baby showers to religious celebrations, your child’s special moments deserve to be remembered in the highest quality possible.

Kids Parties
